system.description:
Toolbelt upgrade of your Elixir S gadget — use this instead of the gadget item to activate it with the greater effect for 2 Toolbelt scraps total.

Gadget — Shrink to Tiny to dodge an attack.

Reaction: When attacked. Become Tiny, 1 round. All attacks against you miss. You can't deal damage or heal allies.

Toolbelt: You have advantage on non-STR saves while Tiny.

Passive: You can choose to be your size or 1 size smaller (this choice lasts until your next Safe Rest).

[A] Spends 2 Toolbelt scraps — tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[M] Take advantage on non-STR saves while Tiny.
